en-US.author: Remco Stoeten
en-US.description: Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.
en-US.longDescription: Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
en-US.name: Skriuw
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes since v2-v0.53.0
- chore(v2): release v2-v0.54.0
- feat(site): run the marketing site and web app on a Cloudflare Worker (#575)
- perf(desktop): start the workspace read before the bundle loads (#574)
- perf(v2): desktop performance pass and shared empty states (#572)
- feat(workspace): redesign the primary rail and notes sidebar (#571)
- feat(v2): redesign the tasks page as a ledger with a detail sheet (#569)
- feat(v2): redesign the journal page as a ledger (#570)
- feat(v2): redesign the settings dialog as a ledger (#568)
- feat(v2): import Skriuw v1 vaults with journal days into the journal (#566)
- fix(workspace): stop the account avatar face reacting to hover (#567)
- fix(mobile): keep WorkManager's Room constructor and speed up the Android e2e (#565)
- feat(mobile): Expo SDK 58, motion layer, quick actions and background sync (#564)
- perf(editor): render a bounded note's viewport first and grow its window when idle (#563)
- refactor(v2): compose editor features through an extension contract (#562)
- refactor(sync): drive desktop and mobile sync through one shared runtime (#561)
- refactor(sync): move sync queue decisions out of the SQLite adapter (#560)
- docs: date the 0.53.0 changelog (#559)
